title: Enforced Approval: Server-side approval of exact agent actions
description: This draft specification states the rules a server follows to refuse an AI agent's write unless an approval exists for that exact change. The server hashes the change, refuses it without a matching approval, and lets a person approve it on the server's own page or through a signed receipt, with single use, bounded grants and a hash-chained audit record. The release includes conformance tests, test vectors and a sandbox server. Draft 0.1.
